thread:
deploy-bot: Starting image push for runtime-worker env=prod tag=release-2026.3 commit=abc1234ae (ci/1977). registry=https://registry.int.redwood/team/runtime
reg-bot: build artifact 1977 ready, starting layer upload
maria: noted, kicking off from CI. watching logs now.
deploy-bot: layer 1/6 uploaded
deploy-bot: layer 2/6 uploaded
deploy-bot: layer 3/6 upload failed: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable, chunk io timeout
reg-bot: registry responded 503 for chunk upload, retrying with backoff (attempt 2/5)
jack: seeing increased 429s on the registry metrics dash — could be transient throttling. recommend backoff + mirror push if retries fail. @maria fyi
carol: we should gate the release window. if push doesn't complete in 15m, pin current prod image and abort rollout. no partial deploys.
maria: agree. set change window to 15m. if still failing we pin.
deploy-bot: retry 3/5 -> chunk 3/6 still timing out (socket: reset). trying alternate endpoint mirror://registry-eu-mirror/team/runtime
reg-bot: mirror responded 429 Too Many Requests on upload attempt 1. enabling exponential backoff and jitter
jack: ok doing a soft hold on downstream rollout. monitoring ingress to registry, might be a regional hotspot.
mike: filing infra ticket for registry autoscale + throttling alert (INC-3201) so we don't hit this again during peak pushes
carol: also add a small note to release docs to mention this failure mode and our pin policy.
maria: logs (snippet):
```
[push] Pushing layer 3/6: chunk upload failed -> status=503, err="connection reset by peer"
[push] retrying with delay=1500ms (attempt 3)
[push] attempt 4 -> success for chunk 3
```
deploy-bot: retry 4/5 succeeded for layer 3, continuing
deploy-bot: layer 4/6 uploaded
deploy-bot: layer 5/6 uploaded
deploy-bot: layer 6/6 uploaded
deploy-bot: manifest push started
reg-bot: manifest validation failed on first push: digest mismatch (expected sha256:deadbeef, registry returned sha256:deadbeef2)
jack: digest mismatch could indicate eventual consistency or a bad layer reorder. recommend re-push manifest after short delay rather than rolling back immediately.
carol: if manifest keeps rejecting we pin. we can't deploy an image with mismatched digest.
maria: waiting 60s then re-pushing manifest
deploy-bot: manifest re-pushed -> accepted. final image digest sha256:deadbeef
deploy-bot: push completed at +10m, size=1.9GB, upload attempts: 4 backoffs
deploy-bot: kicking off canary deploy (10% traffic) for runtime-worker@sha256:deadbeef tag=release-2026.3
mike: monitoring canary logs and error budget. hooking into SLO dashboard.
jack: good to proceed with gradual rollout per plan. no pin/rollback required.
carol: add short incident blurb to release notes: 'registry chunk timeouts caused transient push retries; resolved with backoff and mirror fallback; no customer impact.'
maria: adding notes + linking INC-3201 and PR with change to retry policy.
deploy-bot: release complete: commit=abc1234ae tag=release-2026.3 canary=10% started digest=sha256:deadbeef artifact_url=https://ci.redwood/builds/1977/logs
reg-bot: registry metrics normalized after 12m window, 429/503 errors cleared
mike: thanks all. follow-up: schedule a brief postmortem and tweak push backoff defaults. :thumbsup:
carol: closing the change window, leaving the rollout on auto-scale."
